sentences.back: But they did not write the music down.
It was hard to remember songs.
Later, people wanted to write music down.
These marks helped them remember the notes.
This was the beginning of musical notation.
As history went on, this system kept developing.
It helped composers write more music.
They show how high or low a sound should be.
They also show how long a sound should last.
This development in notation made music richer.
It helped music keep growing over time.
The history of music is closely tied to the way we write music.
